tasks.title: Acquire and fingerprint the authoritative BBS MBCL source
acceptanceCriteria: The source is identifiable as BBS Kitabul Mukkadas MBCL.
The selected 10-book scope is available in machine-readable form or reproducibly extracted from an official BBS-authorized surface.
Source identity, attribution, extraction date, and SHA-256 content fingerprints are recorded.
Raw editorial files are not exposed in the public repository unless approved.
evidence: Bibliatodo exposes the Kitabul Mukkadas text as structured chapter pages and identifies the loaded edition as version 95.
The source page attribution states The Bangladesh Bible Society, 2000 (single column) and 2006 (double column).
Book and chapter mapping is fixed for the existing 10-book scope: 426 chapters total.
Genesis 1:1, Genesis 1:3-5, and John 3:16 exactly matched independent MBCL samples before bulk intake.
A legacy two-part PDF was fingerprinted and rejected because its wording did not match MBCL.
All 426 chapters passed attribution, contiguous range, encoding, and chapter-end coverage validation.
Generated scope: 10 books, 426 chapters, 11,718 ranges covering 12,091 MBCL-numbered verses.
Normalized content SHA-256: c942284f49e0fbef56225c64e0879000b480a54a7b729e16a19d5f93d51558bf.
MBCL John 7 ends at 52 and its John 8:1 includes the sentence commonly numbered John 7:53; this official versification difference is recorded rather than invented.

tasks.title: Create deterministic MBCL import, manifest, and per-book payloads
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical book IDs map to the existing 10 reader books.
Merged verse ranges are preserved without invented splits.
Generated payloads are deterministic and carry source metadata.
evidence: py/import_mbcl_bibliatodo.py provides deterministic, resumable extraction with edition, range, encoding, and chapter coverage validation.
database/mbcl/manifest.js records MBCL publisher, copyright, source, book mapping, chapter coverage, checksums, and the John 7/8 versification exception.
Ten per-book JavaScript payloads were generated for 426 chapters without splitting merged source ranges.
Independent verify-mbcl-integrity.js gate passed: 10 books, 426 chapters, 11,718 ranges, 12,091 covered verses, SHA-256 c942284f49e0fbef56225c64e0879000b480a54a7b729e16a19d5f93d51558bf.
